_meta.description: TrustForge Scoring Configuration — TEF (Trust Evaluation Framework)
_meta.scoring_basis: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025
_meta.note: Update _meta.version and this file together. Never silently change weights without incrementing version.
_meta.coverage_note: UNKNOWN and NOT_APPLICABLE controls are excluded from the denominator. Coverage = evaluated_controls / (total - na_controls).

pillars.name: Notice & Consent
pillars.description: Adequacy of privacy notice, consent mechanisms, and withdrawal options.

controls.title: Privacy notice publicly accessible
controls.description: A privacy notice/policy is accessible from the main website.
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 5 — Notice

controls.title: Grievance/DPO contact in privacy notice
controls.description: Privacy notice contains contact information for Grievance Officer or Data Protection Officer.
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 8(9) — Grievance Officer designation

controls.title: Consent withdrawal mechanism detectable
controls.description: A mechanism to withdraw consent is clearly available (reject button or preference centre).
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 6(4) — Withdrawal of consent

controls.title: No tracker execution before detectable consent
controls.description: Third-party tracking scripts do not execute before a consent signal is detected.
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 6(1) — Consent before processing

pillars.name: Data Principal Rights
pillars.description: Availability of data access, correction, erasure, and grievance workflows.

controls.title: Right to access/summary workflow exists
controls.description: Organization has a defined process for Data Principals to request a summary of their data.
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 11 — Right to access information

controls.title: Right to correction/updating workflow exists
controls.description: Organization has a process for correcting inaccurate personal data upon request.
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 12 — Right to correction

controls.title: Right to erasure workflow exists
controls.description: Organization has a defined deletion/erasure process for Data Principal requests.
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 12(2) — Right to erasure

controls.title: Grievance redressal process exists
controls.description: Organization has a designated Grievance Officer and a formal redressal process.
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 13 — Grievance redressal

pillars.name: Technical Security
pillars.description: Technical safeguards protecting personal data in transit and at rest.

controls.title: HTTPS enforced on public website
controls.description: All public-facing website traffic is encrypted via HTTPS.
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 8(5) — Reasonable security safeguards

controls.title: Encryption at rest claimed/evidenced
controls.description: Organization claims and can evidence encryption of stored personal data.
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 8(5)

controls.title: HSTS header present
controls.description: HTTP Strict Transport Security header present, reducing downgrade attacks.
controls.dpdp_reference: Supporting technical signal — OWASP best practice (not a direct DPDP provision)

controls.title: Incident response procedure exists
controls.description: Organization has a data breach response procedure.
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 8(6) — Breach notification to Board

pillars.name: Processor Governance
pillars.description: Governance of third-party data processors and Data Processing Agreements.

controls.title: Third-party processor inventory maintained
controls.description: Organization maintains an inventory of all third-party Data Processors.
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 8(2) — Processor contracts

controls.title: Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) executed
controls.description: Formal contracts exist with all significant Data Processors.
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 8(2)

controls.title: DPAs reference DPDP Act obligations
controls.description: Processor contracts reference Indian DPDP Act liability clauses.
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 8(2)

pillars.name: Data Retention
pillars.description: Defined retention schedules and automated erasure triggers.

controls.title: Retention schedule defined
controls.description: Organization has a documented data retention schedule.
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 8(7) — Erasure upon purpose completion

controls.title: Automated erasure mechanism for inactive accounts
controls.description: An automated or process-driven mechanism deletes data when the retention period expires.
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 8(7)

controls.title: Retention policy referenced in privacy notice
controls.description: Privacy notice mentions data retention periods or criteria.
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 5(1)(c) — Notice must include retention period

pillars.name: Evidence Verification
pillars.description: Quality and coverage of documentary evidence submitted.

controls.title: Privacy Policy document uploaded and parseable
controls.description: A Privacy Policy PDF or document has been uploaded and successfully parsed.
controls.dpdp_reference: Documentary evidence for regulatory review

controls.title: Corporate identity document uploaded
controls.description: Corporate registration or identity document uploaded (e.g., CIN certificate).
controls.dpdp_reference: Governance accountability requirement

controls.title: Security/audit evidence uploaded
controls.description: Security evidence (SOC 2, ISO, audit report) uploaded.
controls.dpdp_reference: DPDP Act 2023, Section 8(5) — Security safeguards
